description: Java class implementing a FreeMarker template transform for rendering sub-content as text within the OFBiz framework. Handles content rendering, XML escaping, and editing UI wrapping.

classes.name: RenderSubContentAsText
classes.description: Freemarker transform class for rendering sub-content as text in OFBiz.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a custom Writer to handle rendering of sub-content, manages context saving, and calls ContentWorker for content rendering.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of sub-content, handles locale, XML escaping, and editing UI wrapping.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs opening HTML for edit UI wrapping.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs closing HTML for edit UI wrapping.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Determines the CSS style for edit UI wrapping.
